notes: Single CLI plus its visible-run artifact: read solver transcripts and classify each as SAT/UNSAT/NOVERDICT by locating the last verdict-prefixed line, normalizing separators and trailing punctuation, and mapping the value; decoy noise lines mention unsat/satisfiable but must be ignored. Hidden sets probe case variants, punctuation, last-verdict-wins, unrecognized values, and an empty directory. Rubric: reasoning_depth (structured verdict parsing vs substring traps), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (3 hidden sets), quantitative_correctness (exact tokens).
